intended_object: An equivalence that moves effective divisors of degree d to effective divisors of degree e, given a proof that d = e. This comes from the docstring ("Change the degree index ... along an equality").
explanation: This definition is a transport (cast) map. It sends a divisor D to the same D and only re-proves the degree condition using h : d = e. It is the kind of helper Lean needs because of dependent types, like `Equiv.cast` or `finCongr`. Mathematically, the sets of effective divisors of degree d and of degree e are the same set when d = e, so there is no separate mathematical object here. The construction is correct: both directions keep D unchanged, so they are inverse to each other.
